description: This file defines a React functional component 'TeamSSOSettings' that manages and displays team Single Sign-On (SSO) settings, including fetch and update functionalities, rendering a dynamic UI based on schema, and user interactions.

methods.name: fetchTeamSSOSettings
methods.description: Asynchronous function within useEffect to fetch team SSO settings and available models, setting state accordingly.

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Saves the updated settings by calling the update function and handles UI state and notifications.

methods.name: handleTextInputChange
methods.description: Updates the editedValues state when input fields change.

methods.name: renderEditableField
methods.description: Renders different input components based on the schema property type and key, such as dropdowns, switches, or text inputs.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Displays the current value of a setting in a user-friendly format, including handling objects, arrays, booleans, and special cases.
